summary: The letter A is a fist with the thumb resting along the side of the index finger. It's the first letter of the manual alphabet and the base of many other signs.
steps: Close your fingers into a fist.
Rest the thumb straight along the side of the index finger, not across the front.
Palm faces the person you're spelling to.
mistakes: Wrapping the thumb across the fingers. That's S.

faq.q: What's the difference between A and S?
faq.a: A keeps the thumb along the side of the fist. S wraps it across the front of the fingers.
